title: Glabridin mitigates osteoarthritis progression through modulation of the PI3K/AKT/FOXO3A autophagy axis.
authors: Lou, Linbing; Zhu, Zhu; Xu, Lei; Wu, Zhimin; Wang, Xiaofei; Yuan, Luqi; Miao, Haixiang; Xia, Cunyi; Dai, Jihang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Glabridin通过PI3K/AKT/FOXO3A轴调控软骨细胞自噬缓解骨关节炎，虽涉及FOXO3A蛋白与DNA结合，但核心是药物-蛋白互作与疾病机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a common degenerative joint disorder marked by the breakdown of cartilage and disrupted cellular balance. While Glabridin (Gla) has shown properties that are anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, the exact therapeutic mechanism of Gla in the context of OA is not well understood. The goal of this study is to pinpoint and validate the key molecular pathway through which Gla provides protection against the advancement of OA. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to investigate the molecular mechanisms by which Gla regulates extracellular matrix (ECM) metabolism in chondrocytes, revealing critical targets and signaling pathways that mediate its therapeutic impact on osteoarthritis (OA) progression. METHODS: We used a multi-faceted approach, beginning with an integrated analysis of network pharmacology and RNA sequencing to predict Gla's key molecular targets and signaling pathways. We then performed molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) to validate a direct physical interaction between Gla and FOXO3A. The functional consequences were confirmed in human chondrocytes using qPCR, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, and an autophagic flux reporter. We established the central role of FOXO3A by demonstrating that its siRNA-mediated knockdown abolishes Gla's effects. Finally, we assessed Gla's therapeutic efficacy in a mouse model of ACLT-induced OA using histological staining and OARSI scoring. RESULTS: Our results indicate that Gla mitigates IL-1beta-induced ECM degradation by modulating the PI3K/AKT/FOXO3A axis. Gla directly binds FOXO3A, promoting its dephosphorylation and nuclear translocation to activate autophagy-related genes. Local administration of Gla significantly attenuated OA progression in vivo, as reflected by reduced cartilage degeneration and improved OARSI scores. Inhibition of autophagy with 3-MA exacerbated OA pathology, an effect partially reversed by Gla. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrates that Gla protects chondrocytes and attenuates OA progression by directly targeting FOXO3A and activating the autophagy pathway. This mechanism highlights the potential of Gla as a novel disease-modifying agent for osteoarthritis.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨关节炎（OA）是一种常见的退行性关节疾病，其特征为软骨破坏和细胞平衡失调。尽管光甘草定（Gla）已显示出抗炎和抗氧化特性，但Gla在OA中的确切治疗机制尚不明确。本研究旨在确定并验证Gla对抗OA进展的关键分子通路。目的：本研究旨在探讨Gla调节软骨细胞中细胞外基质（ECM）代谢的分子机制，揭示介导其对骨关节炎（OA）进展治疗作用的关键靶点和信号通路。方法：我们采用多方面方法，首先通过网络药理学和RNA测序的综合分析预测Gla的关键分子靶点和信号通路。随后，我们进行了分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）以验证Gla与FOXO3A之间的直接物理相互作用。功能后果在人软骨细胞中通过qPCR、Western blotting、免疫荧光和自噬流报告基因得到确认。我们通过证明siRNA介导的FOXO3A敲低消除Gla效应，确立了FOXO3A的核心作用。最后，我们通过组织学染色和OARSI评分评估了Gla在ACLT诱导的OA小鼠模型中的治疗功效。结果：我们的结果表明，Gla通过调节PI3K/AKT/FOXO3A轴减轻IL-1β诱导的ECM降解。Gla直接结合FOXO3A，促进其去磷酸化和核转位以激活自噬相关基因。局部给予Gla在体内显著减轻OA进展，表现为软骨退化减少和OARSI评分改善。用3-MA抑制自噬加剧了OA病理，而Gla部分逆转了这一效应。结论：我们的研究表明，Gla通过直接靶向FOXO3A并激活自噬通路保护软骨细胞并减缓OA进展。这一机制突显了Gla作为骨关节炎新型疾病修饰剂的潜力。
